description:
In this rehash of an original idea, Superheroes from all corners of the world come to Rick's Pawn Shop from the show Pawn Stars (no relation) to sell their items and make some cash. With Lex Luthor, Spider-Man, Mephisto and Galactus, anything can happen in this here crazy video! Rick's in this too! From the show!
